issue: Two Upper Respiratory Tract Infection AE records have identical start/end dates and severity but conflicting outcomes, and one has an end date with outcome 'not recovered/not resolved', suggesting a duplicate entry.
query_text: Two adverse event records report "Upper respiratory tract infection" with the same start date (2013-10-17), end date (2013-11-04), severity (mild) and relationship (none). AE record 1 has outcome "Not recovered/not resolved", even though it has an end date of 2013-11-04. AE record 4 has outcome "Recovered/resolved". Are these the same event entered twice? If so, please delete the duplicate and confirm the correct outcome. If they are two separate events, please confirm the dates for each one, and check that the outcome on record 1 matches its end date.
